sections.title: Official risky nodes
sections.description: These nodes are part of n8n's official nodes and may be used to fetch and run any arbitrary code in the host system. This may lead to exploits such as remote code execution.
sections.recommendation: Consider reviewing the parameters in these nodes, replacing them with app nodes where possible, and not loading unneeded node types with the NODES_EXCLUDE environment variable. See: https://docs.n8n.io/hosting/configuration/environment-variables/
